title: Add runtime owner, turn, draft, approval, and receipt lifecycle persistence
source_finding: Architecture review requires explicit per-turn leasing, draft CAS, pinned approval, immutable runtime owner, and schema guards.

title: Implement durable v2 turn orchestration on agent-control
source_finding: HTTP-bound model work is not durable and must use leased idempotent tasks with deterministic recovery.

title: Extract editor commit and add portable server draft reducers
source_finding: Approval consumption and exact edit persistence must be one shared transaction without internal HTTP or duplicated browser logic.

title: Reconcile accepted render dispatch and terminal turn continuation
source_finding: Crashes around broker publication and worker terminal writes must converge on one Job/generation.

title: Create direct semantic events, cursor reads, and v1 compatibility
source_finding: Dual event mirroring and repeated full-history polling create split authority, replay, and scaling risks.

title: Add isolated v2 planner/observer contracts and quality evaluations
source_finding: Legacy agent schema cannot be widened safely and observed completion needs receipt/evidence validation plus fallback.

title: Cover state, concurrency, crash, security, format, and user journeys
source_finding: Nineteen new path families need named tests; no silent failure or duplicate side effect may be waived.

title: Extend trace, reconciliation actions, alerts, and runbook
source_finding: Operators must reconstruct turn-to-render outcomes and rescue orphaned durable state.

title: Bound context/drafts and enforce query/queue latency gates
source_finding: Full transcript/editor hydration and shared light-worker contention would degrade long-lived creator threads.
